notes.title: Small performance improvements (1.0.1)
notes.content:
Added settings!
You can select max FPS in-game, disable background animation and falling apples on background. Also you can reset game or case progress in case of problems (doesn't allow to receive one-time cases multiple times).

Fixes:
Performance improvements.
Fixed edge case, where your selected skin apple might reset to default apple.

Linux:
Fix running game on older GLIBC
